subject: a tall Bengali poet with long wavy hair and a full beard, wearing a long loose robe and a shawl draped over one shoulder, gentle deep-set eyes, calm and thoughtful

panels.01-jorasanko: a large old three-storey Calcutta family mansion with tall shuttered windows, wooden balconies and an inner courtyard in 1861, servants and family members in Bengali dhotis and saris, palm trees, warm evening light, wide establishing shot, calm and dignified
panels.02-shelaidaha: {S} as a man of about thirty with dark hair and a dark beard, seated on the deck of a wooden houseboat on a wide river in rural Bengal in 1890, writing in a notebook, farmers and fishing boats on the riverbank, sandbanks and palm trees, soft monsoon light
panels.03-school: {S} with dark hair and a greying beard sitting cross-legged under a large shady tree in 1901, teaching a small group of Bengali boys seated on mats in the open air, books and slates, a simple thatched ashram building behind, dappled sunlight, peaceful
panels.04-gitanjali: {S} with greying hair and beard at a wooden writing desk by a window at night in 1912, translating poems from a Bengali notebook into English on loose sheets of paper, an oil lamp, stacks of handwritten pages, quiet concentration
panels.05-nobel: {S} with grey hair and beard standing in the open air at a rural Bengali school in 1913, surrounded by smiling students and teachers in simple clothes who have just heard joyful news, trees and thatched roofs, celebration, warm light
panels.06-protest: {S} with grey hair and beard seated alone at a desk late at night in 1919, writing a serious letter with a pen, a candle, a grave and determined face, shadows on the wall, quiet resolve, no violence shown
panels.07-painting: an elderly {S} with long white hair and a long white beard bent over a low table in 1930, painting with ink and a brush on paper, bold dark shapes of faces and birds on the sheets around him, brushes and ink pots, an open sunny studio, absorbed and joyful
panels.08-farewell: the courtyard of a large old Calcutta mansion in 1941, a quiet crowd of people in white clothes standing in respectful silence, garlands of white flowers, an empty chair by a window, soft monsoon light, dignified farewell, no body shown
